decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT PERCEPTION-BRANCH READ (owner decision 184; level 2; claim ceiling 'nominated', ruling O1). Per branch (a-agree delivering, b-depth, t-twin): the sealed branch note's candidate list gives gold's rank (1/2/3/absent), top1 and present offline (gold enters only offline); the branch's level-2 first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (score_complete_derived_copy); A's column is A's own first Solver answer. Every contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929); the utterance-level number is reported beside and never gates. (1) THE TWIN NULL: T minus A per metric; the bar = |T - A offset| + its CI95 half-width, reported beside the design's own provisional floor per metric (owner decision 190; stage3_measurement.provisional_floor_pp -- intent 0.6500 pp, SLU 1.4900 pp). (2) PRESENCE: b-depth minus A on gold-on-list (present) in the branch note (primary, ruling O4). NOMINATED (as a presence change) iff the present CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds the twin's present bar. Reported beside, never gating: official intent accuracy and SLU-F1 of the level-2 branch Solver column (B vs A vs T), list size, gold rank, and the conversion of gold at rank 3. A presence nomination opens no system claim: it only informs a later level-2 intent cell on the same pair.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold B development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: branch b-depth: fuse_coverage {'m': 12, 'top_l': 12}; the Fold B re-target and the program switch to phase-native-candidates-review-revise-pbranch3-l2-v1 are the instrument's carrier, shared by every branch
prohibitions: No test-split, DEV or Fold A contact or read (Fold A is the tuning roster and is not re-flown).
No re-flying of the sealed AGREE arm.
No second factor: one axis on the B branch, none on A or T.
No flight before root mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No branch score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a branch effect may only nominate (ruling O1).
No branch value built from Fold B rollouts (owner decision 186).
the_question: At the one Perception visit of every TRAIN Fold B row, does raising the boundary-supply depth itself (fuse_coverage.m and fuse_coverage.top_l together, 8 -> 12, c unchanged) raise the share of rows whose gold intent is on Perception's list beyond the in-flight twin's null, read against the delivering branch A in the same flight, and what does the level-2 branch Solver make of the widened supply?
